ZAF.note: Statement on a funding programme; says nothing of government staff running or building systems.

facts.fact: The DSTI says its Innovation Fund, which has invested R917.2 million through TIA, the PIC and the SA SME Fund since the 2021 pilot, has leveraged more than half a billion rand in private-sector co-investments (cumulative to 21 February 2025).

The DSTI describes the Innovation Fund as structured for public-private co-investment in high-tech SMEs, with private venture capital firms syndicating alongside the state-backed intermediaries and more than half a billion rand of private co-investment leveraged.

systems.owner: Department of Science, Technology and Innovation

facts.fact: The DSTI says its public Innovation Fund has supported 12 venture capital firms and around 96 technology investment opportunities and enterprises, giving catalytic risk capital to early-stage startups and tech-enabled SMEs.

ZAF.note: Names incubators and hubs only as a general objective; no hub or park is described.
